change_class: NEW ENDPOINT — first snapshot; no prior contract to compare against
change_note: Public-safe aggregates for the DARK /carry-tracker page. Serves the weekly paired lift of the HL carry re-ranker against the naive benchmark, live-forward since the 2026-07-21 flip. THE DEFINING PROPERTY: this endpoint computes NOTHING. Every figure is precomputed by src/research/carry/tracker_publish.py in the autonomous-optimizer repo, which imports the canonical readiness derivation (dedupe_paired + assess + stats.block_bootstrap_ci) verbatim and writes carry_tracker_weekly / carry_tracker_pooled; the endpoint is a SELECT plus the exported pure allow-list formatter formatCarryTrackerPublic() in src/lib/carry-tracker-public.ts. There is no in-process import path between Python and TypeScript, so precomputation is how 'the endpoint projects from the derivation, never re-derives it' is realised. A bootstrap, CI, mean or dedupe appearing in the TS module would fork the derivation and let this surface disagree with the flip bar about the same window. UNITS: lift_mean / ci_lb / ci_ub are PER-FUNDING-INTERVAL FRACTIONS (portfolio_net_carry_x2 = mean(|funding_rate|) - turnover cost, gate.realize_interval), rendered on the page in basis points and deliberately NOT annualised. DATA INTEGRITY: differences and interval counts only — portfolio_net_carry_x2 is a portfolio SCALAR and is INTERNAL, and no absolute value leaves here. The rows' window_start and computed_at columns are projected into `since` and `updated_at` rather than passed through; `since` therefore reports the PUBLISHER's stamped window (2026-07-21, the HL flip) and never readiness.LIVE_FORWARD_START (2026-07-05, the ranker go-live), which would misdate the entire claim by 16 days. The flip bar's own READY/WAIT status is deliberately NOT exposed: it is an internal gate token whose vocabulary reads as a recommendation.
source: origin/main src/index.ts app.get('/api/carry-tracker-public') + src/lib/carry-tracker-public.ts formatCarryTrackerPublic(); captured from the live publisher output of 2026-08-13T08:20Z
no_per_week_ci_note: weeks[] carries NO ci_lb/ci_ub by design. block_bootstrap_ci resamples WHOLE ISO-week clusters, so a single week is one cluster and its interval is degenerate — a per-week band would be a confidence-shaped decoration with no sampling behind it. The CI belongs to the pooled object, which is what the pre-registered gate measures.
error_contract: No error path. getCarryTrackerPublic() is fail-open by construction: a read error is caught, logged once, and returns an empty payload with weeks: [], pooled: null and stale: true, so the route always answers 200. The page then renders a LABELLED stale banner rather than a broken surface — a public trust page must not present a database blip as an outage of the thing it reports on.

cache_contract.description: 5-minute in-process module cache plus Cache-Control: public, max-age=300. The underlying producer runs DAILY (01:43 UTC), so a 5-minute TTL is far tighter than the data's own cadence and exists to absorb page-refresh traffic, not to mask staleness.
cache_contract.staleness_signal: stale: true once the PRODUCER's computed_at is older than 26h (one full missed daily slot plus grace). Keyed on the producer's own stamp, never on render time.

consumers: src/lib/carry-tracker-page.ts — server-renders the page from the same getCarryTrackerPublic() call, then re-reads this endpoint client-side every 5 min so a tab left open cannot show yesterday's figures. The server render is the no-JS fallback.
Caddyfile apex — handle /api/carry-tracker-public (the page's live refresh fetches this path RELATIVELY, so the handle is load-bearing for the page, not only for direct API callers)
drift_check_command: curl -fsS https://algovault.com/api/carry-tracker-public | jq -e '(keys == ["pooled","scope","since","stale","updated_at","weeks"]) and (.since == "2026-07-21") and (.scope == "HL") and ([.weeks[] | keys] | flatten | unique == ["iso_week","lift_mean","n","n_deviating","partial"]) and ((.pooled | keys) == ["blocks","ci_lb","ci_ub","lift_mean","n","n_deviating"])' >/dev/null && ! curl -fsS https://algovault.com/api/carry-tracker-public | grep -qE 'portfolio_net_carry|outcome_(return_pct|price)|apr_at_pick|artifact_version'
dark_contract: This endpoint and its page ship DARK: noindex, zero inbound links, and absent from landing/sitemap.xml, landing/llms.txt and landing/llms-full.txt. scripts/indexnow-ping.mjs submits ONLY the <loc> set parsed from sitemap.xml, so absence there also keeps the page out of IndexNow — verified by reading that producer, not assumed. Go-live is pre-registered on the W34 gate (weekly mean lift > 0 AND HL-pooled CI-lb over >= 5 ISO-week blocks > 0, re-checked ~2026-08-24) plus wording approval.
